applies_to: Beilstein J. Org. Chem. (Beilstein-Institut, all articles CC BY 4.0)

signature_features: scope figures open with the general reaction on top, separated from the product grid by a full-width thin grey rule (crops 01, 02)
product yield on the label line: bold label then plain yield, e.g. 2a: 69% (crop 02) or 3m 43% (crop 01)
tert-butyl written t-Bu with an italic t (crops 01, 02)
in multistep schemes the step yield sits in parentheses as the last line under the conditions, e.g. (30%) (crop 05)
sans-serif (Arial-like) text throughout (crops 01 to 07)

notes.yield_placement: after the product label in both scope crops (01, 02); in the total-synthesis scheme (05) the yield is under the arrow in parentheses. Two agreeing crops (01, 02) hold the value; crop 05 is the exception and is recorded under total_synthesis.
notes.yield_separator: no single separator: crop 02 uses a colon (2a: 69%); crop 01 uses a comma in R = ... rows (3c R = OCF3, 69%) and a space for single compounds (3m 43%).
notes.yield_format: {value}% in the product labels of the scope crops (01, 02); the step yield in the multistep scheme (05) is ({value}%) and is recorded under reaction_scheme and total_synthesis.
notes.conditions_split: Crops 01 and 02 put the base or AgNO3 below the arrow with the solvent (Cs2CO3 and H2O in 01; AgNO3 in 02); only crop 05 puts all reagents above and the solvent below. Two agreeing crops are needed, so null.
notes.substrate_layout: Crop 01 (1a + 2b-q) is inline_plus; crop 04 (retrosynthesis, 7 over 8 with a plus) is stacked_plus. Crops 02 and 05 show a single substrate. The crops disagree, so null.
notes.reagent_text_color: Author colouring: NO2, NO3 and HNO3 in red in crops 02 and 03; Ni in dark red in crop 04 (#8A0004); reagent text black in crops 01 and 05. The journal sets no colour, so null.
notes.new_bond_color: Dark red new bonds appear in crop 02 (C-NO2 bond, #800000, Gandeepan et al.), crop 04 (bonds to be formed, #8A3123) and crop 05 (two new C-C bonds of 13, dark red on thin lines, Xiao et al.). The hex differs between papers; author choice, not a journal rule.
notes.highlight_fill: light blue ring fill #BEDAFF in crops 02 and 03 only (one paper); the substrate_scope and catalytic_cycle sections carry the same fill.
notes.arrow_style: plain in crops 01, 02 and 05. Crop 07 (a mechanism, Scheme 5 of Chusov et al.) uses equilibrium double arrows in its top row; mechanism figures are outside this top-level convention.
notes.base_preset: nature is closest on the three ratios; the journal does not redraw author figures, so ratios vary between papers (bond/cap 1.95 in crop 05, 2.48 in crop 02).
notes.measured: Only crops 02 and 05 carry measurements and they disagree. bond/atom-label cap: 2.48 (crop 02: 28.5/11.5) vs 1.95 (crop 05: 19.5/10), card 2.2 is the mean. line/bond: 0.070 vs 0.067, card 0.068 is the mean. bold/bond: 0.123 vs 0.205, card 0.16 is the mean. arrow/bond: 8.3 (crop 02: 236/28.5) vs 4.6 (crop 05: 89/19.5), card 6.4 is the mean. The values are averages of two crops, not values supported by a majority.

evidence.citation: Beller et al., Beilstein J. Org. Chem. 2025 (Pd-catalyzed dehydrogenative arylation of arylhydrazines to access non-symmetric azobenzenes)
evidence.observations: general reaction above a grey rule: catalyst and ligand above the arrow, base, water, solvent, temperature and O2 below; inline + between substrates, plain (1 equiv) after bold labels; product grid with rows like 3c R = OCF3, 69%; Kekule rings; Ph in purple and the aryl-Br bond in dark red (author colouring)

evidence.citation: Gandeepan et al., Beilstein J. Org. Chem. 2025 (Palladium-catalyzed regioselective C1-selective nitration of carbazoles)
evidence.observations: scope grid with blue-filled rings #BEDAFF and blue bonds #255A90; new C-NO2 bond bold dark red #800000, NO2 text red #FF0000; labels as 2a: 69% with superscript footnote a; Pd above the arrow, AgNO3 and solvent below

evidence.citation: Gandeepan et al., Beilstein J. Org. Chem. 2025 (Palladium-catalyzed regioselective C1-selective nitration of carbazoles)
evidence.observations: catalytic cycle: black curved arrows on an open circle; shaded sphere labelled Pd with maroon #8B0542 circular arrows at the centre; bold numbered intermediates 7, 8, 9; Pd2(dba)3 activation arrow entering from the top

evidence.citation: Xiao et al., Beilstein J. Org. Chem. 2025 (Ni-promoted reductive cyclization cascade enables a total synthesis of (+)-aglacin B)
evidence.observations: retrosynthesis with open double arrows; bonds to be formed in dark red #8A3123 with atom numbers in blue #3839FF; key reagent Ni in bold italic dark red #8A0004 above the arrow, then [H] below

evidence.citation: Xiao et al., Beilstein J. Org. Chem. 2025 (Ni-promoted reductive cyclization cascade enables a total synthesis of (+)-aglacin B)
evidence.observations: two-step end game: reagents and DMA, rt, 4 h stacked over and under the arrow with (30%) last; bold labels 5, 13 and (+)-aglacin B (2) with only the number bold; X-ray ball-and-stick model with italic caption

evidence.citation: Chusov et al., Beilstein J. Org. Chem. 2025 (Influence of the cation in hypophosphite-mediated catalyst-free reductive amination)
evidence.observations: free-energy diagram: short thick bars, main path blue #0000FF, side paths orange #FF7F00 and red #FF0000, joined by dashed lines in the same colour; energies in italics above bars, state names in the pathway colour below; axis Gibbs Free Energy (kcal/mol) in italics

evidence.citation: Chusov et al., Beilstein J. Org. Chem. 2025 (Influence of the cation in hypophosphite-mediated catalyst-free reductive amination)
evidence.observations: mechanism with the carbonyl fragment in red #FC0000 and the amine fragment in blue #0000FC; small black curved arrows; charges as plain superscript + and -; phosphorus species in grey rounded boxes with drop shadow; overall drawn as a cycle with black arrows

signature_features: catalyst above the arrow; base and additives each on their own line below, with solvent, temperature and time on one line (crops 01, 02)
step yield in parentheses as the last line under the conditions (crop 05)
reaction_scheme.notes: colours are chosen by the authors; the journal imposes no palette. yield_format rests on crop 05 (step yield in parentheses). Crop 01 product yields are {value}% on the product labels and are recorded under substrate_scope, so the scheme-level format is not {value}%.

signature_features: general reaction on top, a full-width thin grey rule, then the product grid (crops 01, 02)
label and yield on one line under each product: bold 2a then : 69% (crop 02); crop 01 writes bold 3m, a space and 43% for single compounds and R = OCF3, 69% (comma) in R = ... rows
products sharing one core listed as R = ... rows under a single drawing (crop 01)
footnotes as superscript a after the yield
substrate_scope.notes: variation colours differ (purple Ph and dark red C-Br in crop 01; dark red bond and red NO2 in crop 02), and crop 02 also draws the core bonds in blue #255A90, so variation_color is null. highlight_fill #BEDAFF rests on crop 02 alone (light blue ring fill over each product core, unambiguous there); crop 01 has no ring fill, so the fill is one paper's choice.

signature_features: black curved arrows on a circle; substrates enter and by-products (HNO3) leave on short tangent arrows
shaded sphere labelled Pd with two maroon #8B0542 circular arrows at the centre of the cycle
intermediates numbered with bold Arabic numbers under each structure; no step names
catalytic_cycle.notes: rests on one crop; the cycle in crop 07 also uses black arrows but puts key species in grey rounded boxes instead of a centre label

signature_features: fragments colour coded through the mechanism: carbonyl part red #FC0000, amine part blue #0000FC
small black curved arrows, thinner than bonds
phosphorus reagents in grey rounded boxes with a drop shadow
mechanism.notes: rests on one crop. The top row of crop 07 uses equilibrium double arrows; plain curved arrows appear only in the lower cycle, which is not drawn.

signature_features: short thick horizontal bars joined by thin dashed lines in the pathway colour
energy values in italics above each bar; state names (Step_1, TS2->3) in bold pathway colour below
y axis titled Gibbs Free Energy (kcal/mol) in italics; x axis an arrow without ticks
energy_profile.notes: rests on one crop; transition states named TS with arrow subscripts, no double dagger. energy_label is null: the values carry no delta-G symbol, only the y-axis title Gibbs Free Energy (kcal/mol). intermediate_label_style none refers to numbered intermediates; every state carries a name (Step_1, Step_2', TS2->3'', Step_3'' and so on), which the enum does not express. Side-pathway states carry prime marks; two black x marks sit on the orange and red connectors near Step_1. Step_3 is the one state name that sits above its bar; the others are below.

signature_features: open double retrosynthetic arrows with the key reagent (bold italic Ni, dark red #8A0004) above
bonds to be formed in dark red #8A3123, atom numbers in blue #3839FF
each step written in full above and below its arrow, yield in parentheses as the last line
target named with its number in parentheses, (+)-aglacin B (2), only the number bold
X-ray ball-and-stick model linked to the structure by a triple-bar sign, italic caption
total_synthesis.notes: rests on one crop. The two new C-C bonds of 13 are drawn in dark red (crop 05), the same author colouring as the bonds to be formed in the retrosynthesis (crop 04); total_synthesis has no new_bond_color key, so this is recorded here.
